What is OpenCode?

OpenCode is an open source agent that helps you write code in your terminal, IDE, or desktop.

What is OpenCode for Android?

OpenCode for Android is an unofficial port of OpenCode that runs right on your phone as a single self-contained APK.

  • [*]
    Built-in terminal A full terminal on your phone, powered by Termux userland and proot
  • [*]
    Familiar interface The OpenCode web UI you know, bundled right in the app
  • [*]
    Auto-updates The server updates itself

Built for privacy

[*]

OpenCode does not store any of your code or context data, so that it can operate in privacy sensitive environments.
